text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Kuwaiti press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament, government avert confrontation over alleged defence ministry irregularities.

Parliament has asked its public funds protection committee to probe allegations of impropriety. An MP who complained about lack of cooperation from the ministry concerning the accusations said he wanted to question the defence minister.
- Municipality removes 360 farms built on state property.
- Kuwait Investment Company leads trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange after big mid-year profit rise.
- Kuwait to create a mobile telecommunications firm with 49 percent state stake within a year.
- State-owned Kuwait Oil Tanker Company reports 0.8 percent profit fall in fiscal year 1995/96 (June-July).
